Adelaar (2004): The Andean Languages, Cambridge University Press. }} '''Abipón''' is an extinct [[Guaicuruan]] language that was at one time spoken in [[Argentina]] by the [[Abipón people]]. Its last speaker is thought to have died in the 19th century.John Mackenzie (ed.), ''Peoples, Nations and Cultures''.
